summary: Iteration 4 targeted verification of the 'inline editable objectif in CA par commercial' fix on /ventes. Backend is fully green (55/55 pytest incl. new /app/backend/tests/test_team_objectif_iter4.py: GET /api/team?type=commercial shape+no _id, PUT /api/team/{id} {objectif} 200 + persisted via GET + restored, 401 without token, 404 unknown id, GET /api/settings.objectif_ca, GET /api/sales). FRONTEND FIX IS NON-FUNCTIONAL: on /ventes all 8 objectif cells (objectif-cell-<name>) render as DISABLED buttons with NO pencil icon even when logged in as admin; Playwright normal click times out ('locator resolved to <button disabled ...>'), so the inline number input / Check / Cancel never appear and the admin cannot set an objectif from the Ventes table. Root cause found in code (see rca). Everything else passes: gauge (28%->31%) still reads GET /api/settings.objectif_ca; the table lists ALL 8 commerciaux; the new useTeam listeners pattern DOES work (editing Guillaume's objectif to 20000 from the Utilisateurs TeamSection then SPA-navigating to Ventes showed 20 000 € + 0% in the row without a reload); the '+ Nouvelle vente' flow works and CA/count/gauge update instantly (Guillaume 0 € -> 5 000 €, gauge 28% -> 31%). No pageerror, no failed /api call.

ui_bugs.issue: P0 - Inline objectif edit never activates: <CommercialRow key={c.name} c={c} /> at Sales.jsx:340 does not pass isAdmin or onObjectifSaved, AND stats.byCommercial objects (Sales.jsx:182) omit the member id. startEdit() returns early on !isAdmin || !c.id and the button is rendered disabled with no Pencil, for all 8 commerciaux, as admin. Verified by Playwright: every objectif-cell-* is disabled=True, pencil_svgs=0, click times out, objectif-input-* count = 0.

issues: The read-only fallback 'définir' label is shown to every user even when the cell is not editable — for non-admin it reads as an actionable link but is a disabled button; prefer '—' when not editable.

action_items: Sales.jsx:182 — include the member id in the stats.byCommercial mapping: return { id: c.id, name: c.name, ... }.
Sales.jsx:133 — destructure reload from useTeam: const { commerciaux, reload: reloadTeam } = useTeam();
Sales.jsx:340 — pass the props: <CommercialRow key={c.name} c={c} isAdmin={canEditObjectif} onObjectifSaved={reloadTeam} />.
Re-test the inline edit (pencil visible for admin, input + Check + Enter -> toast 'Objectif de <name> mis à jour' -> progression recomputes) after wiring.

useTeam listeners pattern is correct and verified cross-page; keep it.
Sales.jsx is now 351 lines with 3 inline sub-components; consider extracting CommercialRow/ObjectifGauge into components/ before it grows past 700.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/team/{id} with {objectif:N} works and persists (backend verified). The frontend fix is incomplete: Sales.jsx renders <CommercialRow c={c} /> without isAdmin/onObjectifSaved and the aggregated stats.byCommercial object built at Sales.jsx:175-183 drops c.id. Since CommercialRow gates on `disabled={!isAdmin || !c.id}` and `if (!isAdmin || !c.id) return;`, the cell is permanently disabled for everyone, so the user's reported problem (objectif '—' for Kilian/Nolan) is still not fixable from the Ventes page. Workaround today: edit the objectif on Utilisateurs > Commerciaux (team-obj-edit-<id>), which correctly propagates to Ventes via the new useTeam listener.
